review: 702.42b-1: the setup had seven Mountains for a six-mana cost and the decision said all seven paid it; reduced the setup to six Mountains.

scenarios.title: Paying the entwine cost lets a modal spell use all its modes
decisions: A casts Barbed Lightning choosing both modes by paying the entwine cost {2}: the creature mode targets Grizzly Bears and the player mode targets player B. A pays {2}{R} plus {2} with the five Mountains.
Both players pass; Barbed Lightning resolves.

variants.label: entwined
variants.expected: Both modes happen. Grizzly Bears takes 3 damage and dies; B takes 3 damage, life 17.

variants.label: not_entwined
variants.delta: A does not pay the entwine cost, chooses only the creature mode, and pays {2}{R} with three Mountains.
variants.expected: Only the creature mode happens. Grizzly Bears dies; B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: Entwine is available only when its additional cost can be paid
decisions: A considers casting Barbed Lightning, choosing both modes with entwine.

variants.label: five_lands
variants.expected: Casting Barbed Lightning with both modes is legal; the total cost is {2}{R} plus the entwine cost {2}, which five Mountains pay.

variants.label: four_lands
variants.delta: A controls four Mountains instead of five.
variants.expected: Casting with both modes is not legal because the five mana cannot be paid; casting with a single mode for {2}{R} is legal.

scenarios.title: An entwined spell follows the text of its modes in the order written
decisions: A casts Goblin War Party choosing both modes by paying the entwine cost {2}{R}, paying {3}{R} plus {2}{R} with the six Mountains.
Both players pass; Goblin War Party resolves.

variants.label: entwined
variants.expected: The tokens mode is performed first, then the buff mode: A has three Goblin tokens, each 2/2 with haste until end of turn.

variants.label: tokens_only
variants.delta: A does not pay the entwine cost and chooses only the tokens mode, paying {3}{R} with four Mountains.
variants.expected: A has three 1/1 red Goblin tokens without haste.

scenarios.forge_notes: A sorcery, so cast in main1; the tokens get the buff only if the modes run in written order.
